newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's OUB Bank funds Melbourne Airport.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's OUB Bank funds Melbourne Airport.

text.p: OUB Bank said on Monday it was involved in a major syndication loan of Australian $905 million for the privatisation of Melbourne airport.
It said in a statement its Sydney branch was among seven lead managers in a group of 23 international banks which extended the loan to Australia Pacific Airports Corp Ltd (APACL).
The consortium acquired Melbourne Airport from the government for A$1.3 billion earlier this month in the first privatisation of an Australian airport.
OUB said it was the only Southeast Asian bank to take a lead manager role in the loan.

Its aim was to increase its presence in Australasia "by seeking opportunities for strategic involvement and major participation in other privatisation programmes and infrastructure-related transactions in Australia and New Zealand".
